{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS199 |prevtitle=Adding It Up with Plusle & Minun II |nextcode=PS201 |nexttitle=Slugging It Out with Slugma |series=Ruby & Sapphire |colorscheme=Hoenn}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Tripped Up by Torkoal |subtitle=The Red Capes Strike Again |title_ja=VS コータス |title_ro=VS Cotoise |image= PS200.png |scheme=Ruby & Sapphire |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 200 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|16}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 200 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|16}} |location=[[Slateport City]] }} '''Tripped Up by Torkoal''' (Japanese: '''VS コータス''' ''VS {{tt|Cotoise|Torkoal}}''), titled '''VS Torkoal''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 200th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 20th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''The Red Capes Strike Again''' (Japanese: '''赤装束再び''' ''The Team in Red, Once More'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''The Team in Red, Once More''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} reach the end of {{rt|109|Hoenn}} on {{p|Wailord|Lorry}}, with Sapphire disappointed that they never caught up with {{Steven}}. Ruby is frustrated, saying he wants to part ways because Sapphire only ever drags him into trouble and distracts him from his goal. Sapphire retorts by saying he should be thankful that she and Lorry gave him a ride. Ruby gets off onshore, and they each yell at the other to remember their promise. Elsewhere, [[Tabitha]] and [[Courtney]] have joined [[Maxie]] in a hideout as they await the return of [[Blaise]]. Tabitha and Courtney want to stir up trouble now that they've got the [[Scanner]], but Maxie pours himself a drink and insists they should wait for Blaise. Blaise appears, reporting that the [[Submarine Explorer 1]] being built in [[Slateport City]] is already 95% completed. Upon hearing this, Maxie orders the [[Magma Admin (Trainer class)#In the manga|Three Fires]] to go after it, saying that the world will burn and the seas dry up under the scorching fire of [[Team Magma]]. On the way to [[Slateport City]], Ruby's [[Mumu]] evolves into {{p|Marshtomp}}, much to Ruby's delight. He takes a few photos, saying that Mumu is already catching up to [[Nana]] and [[Kiki]]. As he organizes the photos he took, a man approaches him, noting the [[Poké Ball]]s in Ruby's hand and commending him for being a trainer at such a young age. Forcing Ruby's Pokémon out of their Poké Balls, the man praises them before declaring that Ruby will become an honorary member of the [[Pokémon Fan Club]]. The man takes Ruby to the headquarters of the club in Slateport City, revealing that he is none other than the club's [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman|chairman]]. The chairman says that Pokémon are adorable and that it's a waste to battle with them, to which Ruby heartily agrees, complaining that no one else has agreed with him on that point ever since he had moved to [[Hoenn]], and that everyone seems only obsessed with battling. The chairman decides to show Ruby around the city, starting with the {{DL|Slateport City|Slateport Market}}, where they admire various [[decoration]]s on sale. They eventually reach the local [[Contest Hall]], and Ruby declares that it's finally time for his Pokémon to shine in {{pkmn|Contest}}s. Unfortunately, inside the Contest Hall, the two discover that without a [[Hoenn]] [[Contest Pass]], Ruby can't participate in Hoenn Contests. Since Hoenn Passes are only issued in [[Verdanturf Town]], and Ruby doesn't want [[Norman|his father]] to learn he's trying to enter Contests, he tells the Pokémon Fan Club chairman that it's all right and asks whether they can blend {{Berries}} into [[Pokéblock]]s instead. Wanting two more people so that they will have four to operate the [[Berry Blender]] in order to achieve the best [[smoothness]], the chairman races outside and drags in [[Captain Stern|two]] [[Dock|men]] who happened to be passing by the Contest Hall. Outside, the Three Fires watch the four blending Berries inside the Contest Hall, Courtney complaining that it would be too much trouble to separate the man they need out of the group. Blaise suggests that they just grab all of them. In the Contest Hall, the spinning of the Berry Blender is suddenly drowned out by the spinning of something else nearby. When it comes to a stop, it is shown to be a {{p|Torkoal}}, and the smoke it blows chokes the four of them until they faint. Tabitha, Courtney, and Blaise throw the four in a heap onto Torkoal's back. ==Major events== * {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} go their separate ways. * [[Mumu]] evolves into a {{p|Marshtomp}}. * Ruby meets the [[Hoenn]] [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]]. * [[Team Magma]] attack the [[Slateport City]] [[Contest Hall]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Captain Stern]] * [[Dock]] * [[Maxie]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Camerupt}} * {{p|Marshtomp}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * [[Maxie]] * [[Blaise]] * [[Courtney]] * [[Tabitha]] * [[Captain Stern]] * [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] * [[Dock]] * {{pkmn|Coordinator}}s ** Sydney ** Russell ** Alecsey ** Chance ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Mightyena}} ([[Nana]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Delcatty}} ([[Kiki]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Mudkip}} ([[Mumu]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s; evolves) * {{p|Marshtomp}} ([[Mumu]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s; newly evolved) * {{p|Wailord}} (Lorry; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Camerupt}} ([[Maxie]]'s) * {{p|Ninetales}} ([[Courtney]]'s) * {{p|Torkoal}} ([[Tabitha]]'s) * {{p|Swellow}} ([[Blaise]]'s) * {{p|Whismur}} (Whiris; Sydney's) * {{p|Taillow}} (Lolotai; Russell's) * {{p|Slakoth}} (Slokath; Alecsey's) * {{p|Electrike}} (Rikelec; Chance's) ==Trivia== * The [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]]'s introduction scene mimics the Kanto Pokémon Fan Club chairman's introduction scene from ''[[PS010|Danger: High Voltorb]]''. * The four contestants who appear during the Hyper Rank Cuteness Contest, as well as their Pokémon, are all based on {{DL|List of Contest opponents (Generation III)|Normal Rank|Normal Rank Contest opponents}} from {{game|Ruby and Sapphire|s}}. There are, however, some minor differences: ** Russel's {{p|Zubat}}, Zutzu (Japanese: '''ズババ''' ''Zubaba''), has been replaced with a {{p|Taillow}} bearing a very similar Japanese name, Lolotai ('''スババ''' ''Subaba''). ** Alec (Japanese: '''ヒトキ''' ''Hitoki'') and his {{p|Slakoth}}, Slokth (Japanese: '''ケロタロウ''' ''Kerotarō''), had their names slightly changed to Alecsey (Japanese: '''ヒロキ''' ''Hiroki'') and Slokath (Japanese: '''ケンタロウ''' ''Kentarō''), respectively. ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, {{p|Electrike}}'s {{m|Facade}} is referred to as {{m|Charge}}. * In the Chuang Yi translation, {{b|Pecha}} is misspelled as "Peacha". ==In other languages== {| |- style="vertical-align:top" | '''Title''' {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 煤炭龜|VS Torkoal}} (Taiwan)
